ائتمرا (form VIII)
# اِئْتَمَرَا (iʔtamarā) /iʔ.ta.ma.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# اِئْتَمِرَا (iʔtamirā) /iʔ.ta.mi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
